title: Verify mastery: Correlate observability across models, tools, and peers
goal: VC-201-091 (P0) claims mastery of: Carry mission, task, placement, experiment, and deployment IDs through bounded redacted logs, metrics, and traces; one failed distributed request can be followed end to end without recording credentials.. Its own narrative does not claim delivery: PARTIAL: mission routing and provider spans are exported to file and the HTTP exporter respects the egress policy, with an empty batch a no-op. Verified by `crates/susi-core/src/tests/otel_export.rs`: writes_mission_routing_provider_spans_to_file, http_respects_egress_policy, empty_batch_is_noop. Residual: carrying placement, experiment and deployment IDs end to end, and the guarantee that credent. Prove or refute it: add a nonzero test named vc_201_091_mastery_* that exercises the capability on its production path, and record exactly which part is missing when it cannot be proven. Coverage is not mastery: this closes only when the capability is verified, and a linked closed task is not evidence.
